label: Restrict shell access
description: On Plasma 6 this key is read by Dolphin and the file manager context menu only: it hides the terminal panel and the Open Terminal actions. Konsole starts regardless, KIO does not use it for executables and the KRunner command runner follows Disable KRunner. To take the terminal away, hide org.kde.konsole.desktop under Applications and lock the Konsole profile.
windowsEquivalent: Prevent access to the command prompt

label: Disable KRunner (Alt+Space / Alt+F2)
description: KRunner refuses to start at all while this is restricted (its startup job fails), so search, calculator and every other runner go with it; the Run Command menu entry is hidden as well (action/run_command is written with the same value). To keep KRunner but stop it from launching commands, disable the Command Line runner under KRunner instead.
windowsEquivalent: Remove Run menu from Start Menu

label: Restrict logout, shutdown and restart
description: Removes the leave actions from the launcher and the desktop menu (action/logout is written with the same value). Combine with Lock desktop layout for kiosk desktops.
windowsEquivalent: Remove and prevent access to the Shut Down, Restart, Sleep, and Hibernate commands

label: Restrict locking the screen
